dossier_meta.authors: Kelly, Paul J., Ulam, Stanislaw M.
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory
dossier_meta.statement_text: The deck of a graph $ G $ is the multiset consisting of all unlabelled subgraphs obtained from $ G $ by deleting a vertex in all possible ways (counted according to multiplicity). Conjecture If two graphs on $ \ge 3 $ vertices have the same deck, then they are isomorphic.
dossier_meta.context_text: See Wikipedia's Reconstruction Conjecture for more on this problem.
